relationship_description: Brothers, Manuel Sr. is founder of Nickel Asia Corporation, Ronaldo was longtime San Juan Representative and Executive Secretary under Estrada
Married couple, Ronaldo was San Juan Representative (1987-1998, 2001-2022) and Executive Secretary
Father-son, Francis is current Mayor of San Juan City (2019-present), defeated Estrada dynasty in 2019
Father-daughter, Ysabel Maria (Bel) is Representative of San Juan (2022-present)
Father-daughter, Amparo Maria (Pammy) is Representative of Taguig-Pateros 2nd District (2022-present)
Brothers, Salvador (Buddy) is sibling of Ronaldo
Siblings, Francis is San Juan Mayor, Bel is San Juan Representative
Siblings, Francis is mayor, Pammy is Taguig-Pateros Representative
Sisters, both serving as Representatives in different districts
Father-daughter, Manuel Sr. is Representative of Davao de Oro (2001-2010, 2019-present), Carmen was Vice Governor and Congresswoman
Father-son (note: different from mining magnate Manuel Zamora Jr. who is brother of Ronaldo)
Married couple, both served as mayors of Aloguinsan, Cebu (Cynthia 2007-2010, Augustus 2010-2017), both convicted of graft
Father-son, Ignatius (Ig-ig) was Vice Mayor who succeeded his father as Mayor of Aloguinsan after dismissal
